theorem Iceberg.air_approximately_unchanged
  ∀ (t : Iceberg.Tub) (p : Iceberg.Process t) (epsilon : Iceberg.Q),
    p.finalInclusionVolume = 0 →
      0 ≤ epsilon →
        t.inclusionMass ≤ t.rho * t.area * epsilon → Iceberg.Within t.rim p.finalHeight epsilon ∧ p.finalHeight ≤ t.rim

theorem Iceberg.height_balance
  ∀ (t : Iceberg.Tub) (p : Iceberg.Process t),
    t.rho * t.area * (p.finalHeight - t.rim) = t.rho * p.finalInclusionVolume - t.inclusionMass
  -- expr 3834050226
theorem Iceberg.iceberg_root
  ∀ (w a m : Iceberg.Tub) (pw : Iceberg.Process w) (pa : Iceberg.Process a) (pm : Iceberg.Process m)
    (epsilon metalDensity : Iceberg.Q),
    w.rho * pw.finalInclusionVolume = w.inclusionMass →
      pa.finalInclusionVolume = 0 →
        0 ≤ epsilon →
          a.inclusionMass ≤ a.rho * a.area * epsilon →
            m.rho < metalDensity →
              0 < pm.finalInclusionVolume →
                metalDensity * pm.finalInclusionVolume = m.inclusionMass →
                  pw.finalHeight = w.rim ∧
                    Iceberg.Within a.rim pa.finalHeight epsilon ∧
                      pa.finalHeight ≤ a.rim ∧
                        pm.finalHeight < m.rim ∧
                          Iceberg.spilled w (pw.finalStage :: pw.history) = 0 ∧
                            Iceberg.spilled a (pa.finalStage :: pa.history) = 0 ∧
                              Iceberg.spilled m (pm.finalStage :: pm.history) = 0
  -- expr 754371850

    t.rho < metalDensity →
      0 < p.finalInclusionVolume → metalDensity * p.finalInclusionVolume = t.inclusionMass → p.finalHeight < t.rim

theorem Iceberg.residual_height_bound
  ∀ (rho area before after volume mass residual epsilon : Iceberg.Q),
    0 < rho →
      0 < area →
        rho * area * (after - before) = rho * volume - mass + residual →
          -(rho * area * epsilon) ≤ rho * volume - mass + residual →
            rho * volume - mass + residual ≤ rho * area * epsilon → Iceberg.Within before after epsilon
  -- expr 451956655

theorem VE.Alternatives.allowsF_denote

    VE.Formula.denote S (VE.Norms.tupleVal [a, h]) (VE.Alternatives.allowsF A) ↔

            S.relation A.available [a, r] ∧
              ∃ a', S.domain A.action a' ∧ S.relation A.available [a', r] ∧ ¬S.relation A.leadsTo [a', h]

theorem VE.Alternatives.alternative_monotone
  ∀ (A : VE.Alternatives.AltDoc),
    VE.Alternatives.WellFormedAlt A = Bool.true →
      ∀ (S : VE.Structure) (more : S.Carrier → S.Carrier → Prop),
        VE.Norms.Sat (VE.Alternatives.extendAvailable A.alt S more) (VE.Alternatives.altPremises A) →
          ∀ (r h a : S.Carrier),
            (VE.Formula.denote S (VE.Norms.tupleVal [h, r]) (VE.Alternatives.avoidableF A.alt) →
                VE.Formula.denote (VE.Alternatives.extendAvailable A.alt S more) (VE.Norms.tupleVal [h, r])
                  (VE.Alternatives.avoidableF A.alt)) ∧
              (VE.Formula.denote S (VE.Norms.tupleVal [a, h]) (VE.Alternatives.allowsF A.alt) →
                  VE.Formula.denote (VE.Alternatives.extendAvailable A.alt S more) (VE.Norms.tupleVal [a, h])
                    (VE.Alternatives.allowsF A.alt)) ∧
                (VE.Formula.denote S (VE.Norms.tupleVal [a, h]) (VE.Alternatives.preventsF A.alt) →
                  VE.Formula.denote (VE.Alternatives.extendAvailable A.alt S more) (VE.Norms.tupleVal [a, h])
                    (VE.Alternatives.preventsF A.alt))

theorem VE.Closure.Surface.parseRaw_print_named
  ∀ (E : VE.Environment),
    VE.Surface.NamesValid E →
      ∀ (Γ names : List String) (next : Nat),
        VE.Surface.Scope names next →
          names.length = Γ.length →
            ∀ (k : VE.Closure.Kind) (p : String) (t u : VE.Term),
              VE.Closure.Formula.WellFormed E Γ (VE.Closure.Formula.reachNamed k p t u) →
                ∀ (fuel : Nat) (tail : List Char),
                  VE.Closure.Surface.parseRaw E (fuel + 1) names
                      ((VE.Closure.Surface.printAux names next (VE.Closure.Formula.reachNamed k p t u)).fst ++ tail) =
                    Option.some (VE.Closure.Formula.reachNamed k p t u, tail)
  -- expr 1776161558
theorem VE.Closure.Surface.parseStatements_nonempty
  ∀ (E : VE.Environment) (fuel : Nat) (input : List Char),
    input ≠ [] →
      VE.Closure.Surface.parseStatements E (fuel + 1) input = do
        let __discr ← VE.Closure.Surface.parseRaw E (input.length + 1) [] input
        match __discr with
          | (a, rest) => do
            let rest ← VE.Surface.consume ['.', '\n'] rest
            let tail ← VE.Closure.Surface.parseStatements E fuel rest
            Option.some (a :: tail)
  -- expr 254173179

  ∀ {E : VE.Environment} {S : VE.Structure},
    S.Admissible E →
      ∀ (ρ : VE.Valuation S) (k : VE.Closure.Kind) (e : VE.Closure.Edge) (s : String) (t r : VE.Term),
        VE.Closure.Edge.Typed E s e →
          ∀ (x y : S.Carrier),

theorem VE.Core.Surface.parseRaw_print_named
  ∀ (E : VE.Environment),
    VE.Surface.NamesValid E →
      ∀ (Γ names : List String) (next : Nat),
        VE.Surface.Scope names next →
          names.length = Γ.length →
            ∀ (k : VE.Core.Kind) (p : String) (t u : VE.Term),
              VE.Core.Formula.WellFormed E Γ (VE.Core.Formula.reachNamed k p t u) →
                ∀ (fuel : Nat) (tail : List Char),
                  VE.Core.Surface.parseRaw E (fuel + 1) names
                      ((VE.Core.Surface.printAux names next (VE.Core.Formula.reachNamed k p t u)).fst ++ tail) =
                    Option.some (VE.Core.Formula.reachNamed k p t u, tail)
  -- expr 2511736457
theorem VE.Core.Surface.parseStatements_nonempty
  ∀ (E : VE.Environment) (fuel : Nat) (input : List Char),
    input ≠ [] →
      VE.Core.Surface.parseStatements E (fuel + 1) input = do
        let __discr ← VE.Core.Surface.parseRaw E (input.length + 1) [] input
        match __discr with
          | (a, rest) => do
            let rest ← VE.Surface.consume ['.', '\n'] rest
            let tail ← VE.Core.Surface.parseStatements E fuel rest
            Option.some (a :: tail)
  -- expr 1836030701

  ∀ (E : VE.Environment),

theorem VE.Core.Wire.run_certificate_acceptance
  ∀ (profiles : List String) (environment : Lean.Json) (id : String)
    (j result premisesJson conclusionJson certificateJson : Lean.Json) (premiseArray : Array Lean.Json)
    (v : VE.Bridge.Vocabulary) (ps : List VE.Core.Formula) (c : VE.Core.Formula)
    (certificate : VE.Core.Tableau.Certificate),
    VE.Core.Bridge.decodeEnvironment environment = Except.ok v →
      j.getObjVal? "premises" = Except.ok premisesJson →
        premisesJson.getArr? = Except.ok premiseArray →
          VE.Core.Bridge.decodeFormulas v.environment premisesJson = Except.ok ps →
            j.getObjVal? "conclusion" = Except.ok conclusionJson →
              VE.Core.Bridge.decodeFormula 64 conclusionJson = Except.ok c →
                VE.Core.Bridge.checkFormula v.environment c "conclusion" = Except.ok () →
                  j.getObjVal? "certificate" = Except.ok certificateJson →
                    VE.Core.Wire.decodeCertificate certificateJson = Except.ok certificate →
                      VE.Core.Wire.run profiles environment id "certificate" j = Except.ok result →
                        result.getObjVal? "valid" = Except.ok (Lean.Json.bool Bool.true) →
                          VE.Route.Wire.bindingOk profiles environment
                                (List.map VE.Route.Wire.encodeFormula
                                    (VE.Route.Background.literals (VE.Core.Wire.literals v)) ++
                                  premiseArray.toList)
                                conclusionJson certificate.environment_id certificate.premise_meaning_ids
                                certificate.conclusion_meaning_id =
                              Except.ok () ∧
                            ∀ (S : VE.Structure),
                              S.Admissible v.environment →
                                (∀ (b : VE.Formula),
                                    b ∈ VE.Route.Background.literals (VE.Core.Wire.literals v) →
                                      VE.Formula.denote S [] b) →
                                  (∀ (p : VE.Core.Formula), p ∈ ps → VE.Core.Formula.denote S [] p) →
                                    VE.Core.Formula.denote S [] c
  -- expr 221721523

theorem VE.Definitions.acceptance
  ∀ (E : VE.Environment) (ds : List VE.Definitions.Def),
    VE.Definitions.Chain E ds →
      ∀ (lits : List String),
        lits.Nodup →
          ∀ (Γ : List VE.Formula) (φ : VE.Formula) (c : VE.Tableau.Certificate),
            VE.Tableau.checkCertificate E (VE.Definitions.background ds lits ++ Γ) φ c = Bool.true →
              VE.Entails E (VE.Definitions.background ds lits ++ Γ) φ ∧
                (∀ (S : VE.Structure),
                    VE.Definitions.Intended E ds lits S →
                      (∀ (a : VE.Formula), a ∈ Γ → VE.Formula.denote S [] a) → VE.Formula.denote S [] φ) ∧
                  ((∀ (a : VE.Formula),
                        a ∈ Γ → VE.Formula.WellFormed (VE.Definitions.hide E (VE.Definitions.names ds)) [] a) →
                      VE.Formula.WellFormed (VE.Definitions.hide E (VE.Definitions.names ds)) [] φ →
                        ∀ (S₀ : VE.Structure),
                          VE.Route.Background.StringAdmissible (VE.Definitions.hide E (VE.Definitions.names ds)) lits S₀ →
                            (∀ (a : VE.Formula), a ∈ Γ → VE.Formula.denote S₀ [] a) → VE.Formula.denote S₀ [] φ) ∧
                    ∀ (S₀ : VE.Structure),
                      VE.Route.Background.StringAdmissible (VE.Definitions.hide E (VE.Definitions.names ds)) lits S₀ →
                        ∃ S,
                          VE.Definitions.forget (VE.Definitions.names ds) S = S₀ ∧
                            VE.Definitions.Intended E ds lits S ∧
                              ((∀ (a : VE.Formula), a ∈ Γ → VE.Formula.denote S [] a) → VE.Formula.denote S [] φ)
  -- expr 3225267748

    VE.Definitions.Chain E ds →
      ∀ (X : VE.Structure → Prop),

          ∀ (S₀ : VE.Structure),

                  VE.Definitions.forget (VE.Definitions.names ds) S = S₀ ∧

theorem VE.Definitions.conservative_entails
  ∀ (E : VE.Environment) (ds : List VE.Definitions.Def),
    VE.Definitions.Chain E ds →
      ∀ (X : VE.Structure → Prop),
        VE.Definitions.RelationFree X →
          ∀ (Γ : List VE.Formula) (φ : VE.Formula),
            (∀ (a : VE.Formula), a ∈ Γ → VE.Formula.WellFormed (VE.Definitions.hide E (VE.Definitions.names ds)) [] a) →
              VE.Formula.WellFormed (VE.Definitions.hide E (VE.Definitions.names ds)) [] φ →
                ((∀ (S : VE.Structure),
                    S.Admissible E →
                      X S →
                        (∀ (a : VE.Formula), a ∈ VE.Definitions.expand ds ++ Γ → VE.Formula.denote S [] a) →
                          VE.Formula.denote S [] φ) ↔
                  ∀ (S₀ : VE.Structure),
                    S₀.Admissible (VE.Definitions.hide E (VE.Definitions.names ds)) →
                      X S₀ → (∀ (a : VE.Formula), a ∈ Γ → VE.Formula.denote S₀ [] a) → VE.Formula.denote S₀ [] φ)
  -- expr 3210877690

  ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] (E : VE.Environment) (ds : List VE.Definitions.Def),
    VE.Definitions.Chain E ds →
      ∀ (lits : List String),
        lits.Nodup →

                    VE.Formula.eval M [] φ = Bool.false →

theorem VE.Discourse.validity_import
  ∀ (profiles : List String) (environment : Lean.Json) (rv : VE.Route.Wire.RouteVocabulary) (j : Lean.Json) (fuel : Nat)
    (res : VE.Discourse.Admitted),
    VE.Discourse.admitDiscourse profiles environment rv j (fuel + 1) = Except.ok res →
      ∀ (v : VE.Discourse.Validity),
        v ∈ res.claims →
          ∀ (key : String),
            VE.Discourse.refersImport res.doc v.document key →
              ∀ (imp : VE.Discourse.Import),
                imp ∈ res.doc.K.imports ∧ imp.key = key →
                  (imp.bytes = Option.none →
                      res.validity v.unit = Option.some (VE.Discourse.Verdict.unconfirmed "import bytes absent")) ∧
                    (∀ (b : ByteArray),
                        imp.bytes = Option.some b →
                          res.validity v.unit =
                            Option.some
                              (VE.Discourse.verdictOf v.holds (VE.Discourse.checkImport (j.getObjValD "files") b fuel))) ∧
                      ∀ (b : ByteArray),
                        imp.bytes = Option.some b →
                          VE.Discourse.checkImport (j.getObjValD "files") b fuel =
                            VE.Discourse.outcomeWith (fun ps env rv p => VE.Discourse.admitDiscourse ps env rv p fuel)
                              (j.getObjValD "files") b
  -- expr 3264559438

  ∀ {L : VE.English.Lexicon},
    VE.English.Facts L →
      ∀ {xs ys : List VE.English.TermTree},
        (∀ (t : VE.English.TermTree), t ∈ xs → VE.English.TermTree.ok L t = Bool.true) →
          (∀ (t : VE.English.TermTree), t ∈ ys → VE.English.TermTree.ok L t = Bool.true) →
            ∀ (T1 T2 : VE.English.Template),
              (∀ (i : Nat), VE.English.Slot.hole i ∈ T1 → i < xs.length) →
                (∀ (i : Nat), VE.English.Slot.hole i ∈ T2 → i < ys.length) →
                  VE.English.disj L T1 T2 = Bool.true →
                    VE.English.fill T1 (List.map (VE.English.TermTree.yield L) xs) ≠
                      VE.English.fill T2 (List.map (VE.English.TermTree.yield L) ys)

theorem VE.NormDefaults.catala_completed
  ∀ (P N R : Prop) (d : Bool),
    (∃ b, VE.Norms.catalaValue P N d = Option.some b ∧ (R ↔ b = Bool.true)) ↔
      match
        VE.NormDefaults.value3 P N
          (if d = Bool.true then VE.NormDefaults.Completion.allow else VE.NormDefaults.Completion.deny) with
      | VE.NormDefaults.Outcome3.yes => R
      | VE.NormDefaults.Outcome3.no => ¬R
      | VE.NormDefaults.Outcome3.unsaid => True
      | VE.NormDefaults.Outcome3.conflict => False
  -- expr 919815957
theorem VE.NormDefaults.catala_unspecified
  ∀ (P N R V : Prop),
    (∃ b, VE.Norms.catalaValue (P ∨ V ∧ ¬P ∧ ¬N) N Bool.false = Option.some b ∧ (R ↔ b = Bool.true)) ↔
      (match VE.NormDefaults.value3 P N VE.NormDefaults.Completion.unspecified with
        | VE.NormDefaults.Outcome3.yes => R
        | VE.NormDefaults.Outcome3.no => ¬R
        | VE.NormDefaults.Outcome3.unsaid => True
        | VE.NormDefaults.Outcome3.conflict => False) ∧
        (VE.NormDefaults.value3 P N VE.NormDefaults.Completion.unspecified = VE.NormDefaults.Outcome3.unsaid → (R ↔ V))
  -- expr 2554669392

theorem VE.NormDefaults.forIn_cons_ok
  ∀ {α σ ε : Type} (f : α → σ → Except ε (ForInStep σ)) (step : σ → σ) (cond : Prop) (x : α) (l : List α) (s s' : σ),
    ((f x s = Except.ok (ForInStep.yield (step s)) ↔ cond) ∧
        ∀ (r : ForInStep σ), f x s = Except.ok r → r = ForInStep.yield (step s)) →
      (ForIn.forIn (x :: l) s f = Except.ok s' ↔ cond ∧ ForIn.forIn l (step s) f = Except.ok s')
  -- expr 3337818268

                      ∀ (vs : List α),

theorem VE.NormDefaults.outcomeBase_fill
  ∀ {U : VE.NormDefaults.UDoc},
    VE.NormDefaults.WellFormedU U = Bool.true →
      ∀ {B : VE.Structure},
        VE.Norms.ConstantsTyped (VE.NormDefaults.fill U) B →
          ∀ {q : VE.Norms.Regulated},
            q ∈ U.D.T.regulated →
              ∀ (vs : List B.Carrier),
                VE.TupleTyped B q.sorts vs →
                  (VE.Formula.denote B (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs) (VE.Norms.outcomeBase (VE.NormDefaults.fill U) q.name) ↔
                    if q.allowByDefault = Bool.true then
                      ¬VE.Norms.DecidesD (VE.NormDefaults.fill U).T (VE.SoftNorms.canon (VE.NormDefaults.fill U) B)
                          (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs) q.name Bool.false
                    else
                      VE.Norms.DecidesD (VE.NormDefaults.fill U).T (VE.SoftNorms.canon (VE.NormDefaults.fill U) B)
                        (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs) q.name Bool.true)
  -- expr 1559629451

        VE.NormDefaults.NodeOK D N ∧ ¬N.name ∈ names ∧ k + VE.NormDefaults.ruleNodes N ≤ 10000) ∧
      ∀ (x : ForInStep (MProd (List String) Nat)),
        VE.NormDefaults.ruleBody D N ⟨names, k⟩ = Except.ok x →
          x = ForInStep.yield ⟨names ++ [N.name], k + VE.NormDefaults.ruleNodes N⟩
  -- expr 1944237460

theorem VE.NormDefaults.rulesLoop_ok
  ∀ (D : VE.Norms.Doc) (L : List VE.Norms.Node) (names : List String) (k : Nat) (s' : MProd (List String) Nat),
    ForIn.forIn L ⟨names, k⟩ (VE.NormDefaults.ruleBody D) = Except.ok s' ↔
      (∀ (N : VE.Norms.Node), N ∈ L → VE.NormDefaults.NodeOK D N) ∧
        (List.map VE.Norms.Node.name L).Nodup ∧
          (∀ (N : VE.Norms.Node), N ∈ L → ¬N.name ∈ names) ∧
            (L ≠ [] → k + (List.map VE.NormDefaults.ruleNodes L).sum ≤ 10000) ∧
              s' = ⟨names ++ List.map VE.Norms.Node.name L, k + (List.map VE.NormDefaults.ruleNodes L).sum⟩

theorem VE.NormDefaults.yields_fuel_unfold
  ∀ {T : VE.Norms.Tree},
    VE.Route.DagAcyclic (VE.Norms.precedenceNodes T) →
      ∀ (S : VE.Structure) (ρ : VE.Valuation S) {N : VE.Norms.Node},
        N ∈ T.nodes →
          (VE.Norms.YieldsD T S ρ (VE.Norms.fuel T) N ↔
            VE.Norms.AppliesD S ρ N ∨ ∃ C, C ∈ VE.Norms.children T N ∧ VE.Norms.YieldsD T S ρ (VE.Norms.fuel T) C)
  -- expr 754328354
theorem VE.NormDefaults.yields_iff_selects
  ∀ {T : VE.Norms.Tree},
    VE.Route.DagAcyclic (VE.Norms.precedenceNodes T) →
      ∀ (S : VE.Structure) (ρ : VE.Valuation S),
        (∀ (N : VE.Norms.Node),
            N ∈ T.nodes → ∀ (m : String), m ∈ N.over → ∃ M, M ∈ T.nodes ∧ M.name = m ∧ M.pred = N.pred) →
          ∀ (p : String),
            (∃ C, C ∈ T.nodes ∧ C.pred = p ∧ C.over = [] ∧ VE.Norms.YieldsD T S ρ (VE.Norms.fuel T) C) ↔
              ∃ N, N ∈ T.nodes ∧ N.pred = p ∧ VE.Norms.SelectsD T S ρ (VE.Norms.fuel T) N

  -- expr 1793615302
theorem VE.NormDefaults.yields_mono
  ∀ (T : VE.Norms.Tree) (f g : Nat) (N : VE.Norms.Node),
    f ≤ g →
      (VE.Norms.Formula.qfree (VE.Norms.yields T g N) = Bool.true →
          VE.Norms.Formula.qfree (VE.Norms.yields T f N) = Bool.true) ∧
        ∀ (q : String), q ∈ VE.Norms.preds (VE.Norms.yields T f N) → q ∈ VE.Norms.preds (VE.Norms.yields T g N)
  -- expr 2377802109

        N ∈ T.nodes →
          VE.NormDefaults.belowCount T N ≤ f →
            VE.NormDefaults.belowCount T N ≤ g → (VE.Norms.YieldsD T S ρ f N ↔ VE.Norms.YieldsD T S ρ g N)

      VE.Norms.InFragment D = Bool.true →

                          ∃ α inst M ws,

                                    VE.Formula.eval M (VE.Norms.tupleVal ws) (VE.Norms.pairConflict D pr) = Bool.true

  ∀ (T : VE.Norms.Tree) (r : VE.Norms.Regulated),
    VE.Norms.Arity r.sorts →
      ∀ (S : VE.Structure) (vs : List S.Carrier),
        VE.TupleTyped S r.sorts vs →
          (VE.Formula.denote S (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs) (VE.Norms.elabBody T r) ↔
            (VE.Formula.denote S (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs) (VE.Norms.pos T r.name) → S.relation r.name vs) ∧
              (VE.Formula.denote S (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs) (VE.Norms.neg T r.name) → ¬S.relation r.name vs) ∧
                (¬VE.Formula.denote S (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs) (VE.Norms.pos T r.name) ∧
                    ¬VE.Formula.denote S (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs) (VE.Norms.neg T r.name) →
                  (S.relation r.name vs ↔ r.allowByDefault = Bool.true)))
  -- expr 139334749

  -- expr 1858114388
theorem VE.Norms.elab_completion
  ∀ (T : VE.Norms.Tree) (r : VE.Norms.Regulated),
    VE.Norms.Arity r.sorts →
      ∀ (S : VE.Structure),
        (∀ (vs : List S.Carrier),
            VE.TupleTyped S r.sorts vs →
              ¬(VE.Formula.denote S (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs) (VE.Norms.pos T r.name) ∧
                  VE.Formula.denote S (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs) (VE.Norms.neg T r.name))) →
          (VE.Formula.denote S [] (VE.Norms.elabPremise T r) ↔
            ∀ (vs : List S.Carrier),
              VE.TupleTyped S r.sorts vs →
                (S.relation r.name vs ↔ VE.Formula.denote S (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs) (VE.Norms.outcome T r)))

    VE.Norms.Arity r.sorts →

        (∀ (ρ : VE.Valuation S) (sign : Bool),

theorem VE.Norms.norms_route_acceptance
  ∀ (D : VE.Norms.Doc),
    VE.Norms.WellFormed D = Bool.true →
      (∀ (B : VE.Structure), VE.Norms.BaseAdmissible D B → VE.Norms.ConflictFree D B) →
        ∀ (Γ : List VE.Formula) (φ : VE.Formula) (c : VE.Tableau.Certificate),
          VE.Tableau.checkCertificate (VE.Norms.envAt D (VE.Norms.size D))
                (VE.Norms.background D ++ VE.Norms.elaborate D.T ++ Γ) φ c =
              Bool.true →
            (∀ (S : VE.Structure),
                S.Admissible (VE.Norms.envAt D (VE.Norms.size D)) →
                  VE.Norms.holdsCatala D.T S →
                    VE.Norms.definitionsHold D S →
                      VE.Norms.profileHold D S →
                        VE.Norms.Sat S (VE.Norms.backgroundBase D) → VE.Norms.Sat S Γ → VE.Formula.denote S [] φ) ∧
              ((∀ (a : VE.Formula), a ∈ Γ → VE.Formula.WellFormed (VE.Norms.envAt D 0) [] a) →
                VE.Formula.WellFormed (VE.Norms.envAt D 0) [] φ →
                  ∀ (B : VE.Structure), VE.Norms.BaseAdmissible D B → VE.Norms.Sat B Γ → VE.Formula.denote B [] φ)
  -- expr 2592662421

    S.Admissible E →
      ∀ (b : VE.Order.Tableau.Branch) (ρ : VE.Order.Tableau.Assignment S),

          VE.Order.Tableau.Branch.Holds S ρ b →
            VE.Order.Tableau.Defined S ρ b →
              ∀ (bs cs : List VE.Order.Tableau.Token),
                (∀ (t : VE.Order.Tableau.Token), t ∈ bs → ∃ v, VE.Order.Tableau.Token.denote S ρ t = Option.some v) →
                  (∀ (t : VE.Order.Tableau.Token), t ∈ cs → ∃ v, VE.Order.Tableau.Token.denote S ρ t = Option.some v) →

                      VE.Order.Tableau.sameValue E b bs t cs u = Bool.true →
                        ∃ v,
                          VE.Order.Term.denote S (VE.Order.Tableau.bindingsValue S ρ bs) t = Option.some v ∧

theorem VE.Readings.distinctAcrossSets_spec
  ∀ (D : VE.Readings.Doc),
    VE.Readings.distinctAcrossSets D = Bool.true ↔
      (∀ (R : VE.Readings.ReadingSet),
          R ∈ D.sets →
            ∀ (n : String × String),
              n ∈ VE.Readings.declaredBy R →
                ∀ (u : String) (c : VE.Compose.Content) (cs : List (String × List String)),
                  VE.Readings.Item.fixed u c cs ∈ D.items → ∀ (m : String × String), m ∈ c.declared → m.snd ≠ n.snd) ∧
        (∀ (R : VE.Readings.ReadingSet),
            R ∈ D.sets →
              ∀ (n : String × String),
                n ∈ VE.Readings.declaredBy R →
                  ∀ (u : String) (b : VE.Rights.Bar), VE.Readings.Item.bar u b ∈ D.items → b.name ≠ n.snd) ∧
          (∀ (R : VE.Readings.ReadingSet),
              R ∈ D.sets →
                ∀ (R' : VE.Readings.ReadingSet),
                  R' ∈ D.sets →
                    R.id ≠ R'.id →
                      ∀ (n : String × String),
                        n ∈ VE.Readings.declaredBy R →
                          ∀ (m : String × String), m ∈ VE.Readings.declaredBy R' → m.snd ≠ n.snd) ∧
            List.Pairwise (fun x y => ∀ (n : String), n ∈ x.names → ¬n ∈ y.names) D.items
  -- expr 2917254328

  ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] (D : VE.Readings.Doc) (s : String) (i j : Nat) (M : VE.FiniteModel α)
    (F : List (VE.Readings.GenKey × List (List α))),
    VE.Readings.ownedKeys D s i = [] →
      VE.Readings.ownedKeys D s j = [] →
        (∀ (t : VE.Readings.GenKey × List (List α)),
            t ∈ F →
              VE.Readings.owned D s i t.fst = Bool.false ∧
                VE.Readings.owned D s j t.fst = Bool.false ∧
                  (((VE.Readings.genKeys (VE.Readings.one D s i).fst).any fun x => x.fst == t.fst) ||
                      (VE.Readings.genKeys (VE.Readings.one D s j).fst).any fun x => x.fst == t.fst) =
                    Bool.true) →
          (List.map (fun x => x.fst) F).Nodup →
            VE.Readings.sideValid D s i M (VE.Readings.tablesFor D s i F) = Bool.true →
              VE.Readings.sideValid D s j M (VE.Readings.tablesFor D s j F) = Bool.true →
                ((∃ q,
                    q ∈ VE.Readings.probesOf D M ∧
                      ∃ v,

                            Bool.true) ↔
                  VE.Readings.observeAll D s i M F ≠ VE.Readings.observeAll D s j M F)

theorem VE.Readings.tablesModel_rel
  ∀ {α : Type u} (X : VE.Rights.RightsDoc) (M : VE.FiniteModel α) (T : List (VE.Readings.GenKey × List (List α)))
    (G : VE.Readings.Tables α),
    (∀ (p : String) (g : VE.Readings.GenKey × String × List String),
        List.find? (fun x => x.snd.fst == p) (VE.Readings.genKeys X) = Option.some g →
          ∀ (vs : List α), vs ∈ VE.Readings.tableOf T g.fst ↔ G g.fst vs) →
      (fun p vs => vs ∈ (VE.Readings.tablesModel X M T).relations p) = fun p vs =>
        match List.find? (fun x => x.snd.fst == p) (VE.Readings.genKeys X) with
        | Option.some g => G g.fst vs
        | Option.none => vs ∈ M.relations p

                  (VE.Reports.Content.report h₂ VE.Reports.Act.believes c' (VE.Reports.Content.formula q) Option.none)
                  lit →
              VE.Reports.bridgeFormula D { unit := u.id, depth := 0 } =
                  VE.Reports.elab D
                    (VE.Reports.Content.report h₂ VE.Reports.Act.believes c' (VE.Reports.Content.formula q) Option.none) ∧
                VE.Reports.bridgeFormula D { unit := u.id, depth := 1 } = Option.some q ∧
                  VE.Reports.elab D
                      (VE.Reports.Content.report h₂ VE.Reports.Act.believes c' (VE.Reports.Content.formula q)
                        Option.none) ≠
                    Option.some q
  -- expr 3900631864

          ∀ (h₁ h₂ c c' s₂ : String) (act : VE.Reports.Act) (q : VE.Formula) (lit : Option String),
            u.content =
                VE.Reports.Content.report h₁ act c

                  lit →
              VE.Reports.holderSort D h₂ = Option.some s₂ →
                ¬{ act := VE.Reports.Act.believes, sort := s₂, ctx := c',
                        content := VE.Reports.complementId D (VE.Reports.Content.formula q) Option.none } ∈
                      VE.Reports.topKeys D →
                  ∀ (S₀ : VE.Structure),
                    S₀.Admissible D.E →
                      VE.Reports.Expandable D S₀ →
                        ¬VE.Formula.denote S₀ [] q →
                          ∃ M,
                            M.S = S₀ ∧

                                    ¬M.J VE.Reports.Act.believes s₂ c'

  ∀ (profiles : List String) (environment j : Lean.Json) (res : VE.Reports.ReportsAdmitted),
    VE.Reports.admissionReports profiles environment j = Except.ok res →
      VE.Reports.WellFormedReports res.D = Bool.true ∧
        (∃ c, VE.Reports.Wire.decodeDocument environment j = Except.ok c ∧ c.dec.D = res.D) ∧
          VE.Route.Wire.environmentId profiles environment = Except.ok res.envelope.fst ∧
            res.envelope.snd = VE.Reports.documentId res.D ∧
              (∃ g ns,
                  j.getObjVal? "graph" = Except.ok g ∧
                    g.getObjVal? "nodes" = Except.ok ns ∧ ns.getArr? = Except.ok res.graphNodes.toArray) ∧
                (∀ (n : Lean.Json),
                    n ∈ res.graphNodes →
                      VE.Reports.hasField n "certificate" = Bool.true →
                        VE.Reports.envelopeMatches res.envelope.fst res.envelope.snd (n.getObjValD "envelope") =
                          Bool.true) ∧
                  res.graph.nodes = List.map VE.Route.Admission.WireNode.toNode res.wires ∧
                    VE.Graph.Acyclic res.graph ∧
                      (List.map (fun n => n.claim.name) res.graph.nodes).Nodup ∧
                        res.report.root.name = res.graph.root ∧
                          VE.Graph.SoundReport (VE.Reports.envReports res.D) res.graph res.report ∧
                            (∀ (w : VE.Route.Admission.WireNode),
                                w ∈ res.wires → VE.Reports.ReportsNodeAdmitted res.D w) ∧
                              (∀ (leaf : VE.Graph.Claim),
                                  leaf ∈ res.report.assumptions →
                                    ∃ w,
                                      w ∈ res.wires ∧
                                        w.claim = leaf ∧
                                          w.deduction = Option.none ∧ VE.Reports.ReportsLeafAdmitted res.D w) ∧
                                VE.Route.Admission.CitationsClosed (VE.Reports.w2Doc res.D) res.report ∧
                                  VE.Route.Admission.ChoicesCompatible res.report
  -- expr 726498701

theorem VE.Reports.reports_route_acceptance
  ∀ (D : VE.Reports.ReportDoc),
    VE.Reports.WellFormedReports D = Bool.true →
      D.lits.Nodup →
        ∀ (Γ : List VE.Formula) (φ : VE.Formula) (c : VE.Tableau.Certificate),
          VE.Tableau.checkCertificate (VE.Reports.envReports D) (VE.Reports.checkedList D Γ) φ c = Bool.true →
            VE.Entails (VE.Reports.envReports D) (VE.Reports.checkedList D Γ) φ ∧
              VE.Route.Background.EntailsString (VE.Reports.envReports D) D.lits (VE.Reports.premises D ++ Γ) φ ∧
                (∀ (S' : VE.Structure),
                    VE.Route.Background.StringAdmissible (VE.Reports.envReports D) D.lits S' →
                      VE.Reports.IntendedReports D (VE.Reports.restrictJ D S') →
                        VE.Route.fol.Sat S' Γ → VE.Formula.denote S' [] φ) ∧
                  ∀ (M : VE.Reports.Source D),
                    VE.Route.Background.StringAdmissible D.E D.lits M.S →
                      VE.Reports.IntendedReports D M →
                        VE.Route.fol.Sat (VE.Reports.interp D M) Γ → VE.Formula.denote (VE.Reports.interp D M) [] φ
  -- expr 3666085014

theorem VE.Reports.scoped_witness_sound
  ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] (D : VE.Reports.ReportDoc),
    VE.Reports.WellFormedReports D = Bool.true →
      ∀ (s : VE.Reports.ScopedCheck),
        s ∈ D.scoped →
          ∀ (Eq : VE.Reports.Pinned) (ps : List VE.Formula),
            VE.Reports.payloadFormulas D s = Option.some (Eq, ps) →
              ∀ (Mo : VE.FiniteModel α),
                Mo.Valid Eq.env →
                  (∀ (a : VE.Formula), a ∈ VE.Reports.background Eq → VE.Formula.eval Mo [] a = Bool.true) →

                      VE.Formula.eval Mo [] s.conclusion = Bool.false →
                        ¬VE.Entails Eq.env (VE.Reports.background Eq ++ ps) s.conclusion

theorem VE.Reports.unit_shape
  ∀ {D : VE.Reports.ReportDoc},
    VE.Reports.WF D →
      ∀ {u : VE.Reports.Unit},
        u ∈ D.units →
          (∃ h act c b lit s,
              u.content = VE.Reports.Content.report h act c b lit ∧
                VE.Reports.holderSort D h = Option.some s ∧
                  VE.Reports.unitPremise D u =
                    Option.some
                      (VE.Formula.unary
                        (VE.Reports.reportName D
                          { act := act, sort := s, ctx := c, content := VE.Reports.complementId D b lit })
                        (VE.Term.const h))) ∨
            (∃ j a b r,
                u.content = VE.Reports.Content.assessment j a b ∧
                  VE.Reports.recordOf D a = Option.some r ∧
                    VE.Reports.unitPremise D u =
                      Option.some
                        (VE.Formula.unary
                          (VE.Reports.assessName D { j := j, a := a, content := VE.Reports.contentId D b })
                          (VE.Term.const r.context))) ∨
              (∃ h act c b lit s,
                  u.content = (VE.Reports.Content.report h act c b lit).negated ∧
                    VE.Reports.holderSort D h = Option.some s ∧
                      VE.Reports.unitPremise D u =
                        Option.some
                          (VE.Formula.unary
                              (VE.Reports.reportName D
                                { act := act, sort := s, ctx := c, content := VE.Reports.complementId D b lit })
                              (VE.Term.const h)).not) ∨
                ∃ j a b r,
                  u.content = (VE.Reports.Content.assessment j a b).negated ∧
                    VE.Reports.recordOf D a = Option.some r ∧
                      VE.Reports.unitPremise D u =
                        Option.some
                          (VE.Formula.unary
                              (VE.Reports.assessName D { j := j, a := a, content := VE.Reports.contentId D b })
                              (VE.Term.const r.context)).not
  -- expr 2434304188

                    over := __src.over, mode := __src.mode, rank := __src.rank, alterable := __src.alterable,
                    exception := __src.exception, hard := __src.hard })
                (VE.Rights.linesOf D) ++
              D.soft.T.nodes

theorem VE.Rights.limitation_scope_sound
  ∀ (D : VE.Rights.RightsDoc),
    VE.Rights.WellFormedRights D = Bool.true →
      ∀ (certs : List (Option VE.Tableau.Certificate)),
        VE.Rights.limitationScope D certs = [] →
          ∀ (L : VE.Rights.Limitation),
            L ∈ D.limits →
              ∀ (R : String) (N : VE.Rights.Line),
                (R, N) ∈ VE.Rights.linesOf D →
                  VE.Rights.inScope D L R N = Bool.true →
                    ∀ (B : VE.Structure),
                      VE.Rights.BaseAdmissibleR D B →
                        ∀ (vs : List B.Carrier),
                          VE.TupleTyped B (VE.Rights.sortsOf D N) vs →
                            VE.Formula.denote B (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs)
                                (VE.Rights.outcomeSubst D (VE.Rights.ownGuard D N)) →
                              ¬VE.Formula.denote B (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs)
                                    (VE.Rights.outcomeSubst D (VE.Rights.selectsR D N)) →
                                VE.Formula.denote B (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs) (VE.Rights.limPack D N) ∨
                                  (∃ n,
                                      n ∈ VE.Rights.narrowings D N ∧
                                        VE.Rights.cited D N n = Bool.true ∧
                                          VE.Formula.denote B (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs)
                                            (VE.Rights.outcomeSubst D (VE.Rights.condF D N n))) ∨
                                    (∃ n,
                                        n ∈ VE.Rights.narrowings D N ∧
                                          VE.Rights.rightCollision D N n = Bool.true ∧
                                            VE.Formula.denote B (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs)
                                              (VE.Rights.outcomeSubst D (VE.Rights.condF D N n))) ∨
                                      (∃ M,
                                          VE.Rights.sameEffectStrict D N M = Bool.true ∧
                                            VE.Formula.denote B (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs)
                                              (VE.Rights.outcomeSubst D
                                                (VE.Rights.condF D N (VE.Rights.Narrowing.blockedBy M)))) ∨
                                        VE.Rights.ruleReading D = Bool.true ∧
                                          ∃ m,
                                            VE.Rights.barReach D N = Option.some m ∧
                                              VE.Formula.denote B (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs) (VE.Rights.aimedF D m)

        ∀ (Γ : List VE.Formula) (φ : VE.Formula),
          (∀ (a : VE.Formula),
              a ∈ Γ → VE.Formula.WellFormed (VE.Norms.envAt (VE.SoftNorms.soften (VE.Rights.correlate D)) 0) [] a) →
            VE.Formula.WellFormed (VE.Norms.envAt (VE.SoftNorms.soften (VE.Rights.correlate D)) 0) [] φ →
              ∀ (B : VE.Structure),
                VE.Rights.BaseAdmissibleR D B →
                  VE.Norms.Sat B Γ →
                    ¬VE.Formula.denote B [] φ →
                      ∃ S,
                        VE.Norms.DocumentExpansion (VE.SoftNorms.soften (VE.Rights.correlate D)) B S ∧
                          VE.Norms.Sat S (VE.SoftNorms.softPremises (VE.Rights.correlate D)) ∧

    VE.Risk.WellFormedRisk R = Bool.true →

theorem VE.Risk.sign_regions
  ∀ (c K y : Int),
    c ≠ 0 →
      have fl := (VE.Risk.floorCeil K c).fst;
      (y ≤ fl - 1 → (0 < c → c * y + K < 0) ∧ (c < 0 → 0 < c * y + K)) ∧
        (fl + 1 ≤ y → (0 < c → 0 < c * y + K) ∧ (c < 0 → c * y + K < 0))
  -- expr 3663993070
theorem VE.Risk.sign_step
  ∀ (c K x : Int),
    c ≠ 0 →
      ¬x ∈
              [(VE.Risk.floorCeil K c).fst - 1, (VE.Risk.floorCeil K c).fst, (VE.Risk.floorCeil K c).snd,
                (VE.Risk.floorCeil K c).snd + 1] ∨
          ¬x + 1 ∈
              [(VE.Risk.floorCeil K c).fst - 1, (VE.Risk.floorCeil K c).fst, (VE.Risk.floorCeil K c).snd,
                (VE.Risk.floorCeil K c).snd + 1] →
        VE.Risk.SignEq (c * x + K) (c * (x + 1) + K)

theorem VE.Risk.stepEq_eval
  ∀ (b : VE.Risk.Box),
    b.WF →
      ∀ (f : VE.Risk.LinForm),
        f.Normal →
          ∀ (l : List (String × Int)) (v : VE.Risk.Valuation) (need : Int),
            (List.map (fun x => x.fst) l).Nodup →
              (∀ (p : String × Int), p ∈ l → p ∈ f.coeffs) →
                (∀ (p : String × Int), p ∈ l → v p.fst = if 0 ≤ p.snd then b.lo p.fst else b.hi p.fst) →
                  0 ≤ need →
                    f.eval (VE.Risk.stepEq b l v need) = f.eval v + Min.min need (VE.Risk.capacity b l) ∧
                      (∀ (q : String), ¬q ∈ List.map (fun x => x.fst) l → VE.Risk.stepEq b l v need q = v q) ∧
                        ∀ (p : String × Int),
                          p ∈ l →
                            b.lo p.fst ≤ VE.Risk.stepEq b l v need p.fst ∧ VE.Risk.stepEq b l v need p.fst ≤ b.hi p.fst
  -- expr 1914872267

theorem VE.Risk.walk
  ∀ {α : Type} {O : Int → α} {C : List Int} (dir : VE.Risk.Dir) (cur : Int),
    cur + 1 ∈ C →
      cur - 1 ∈ C →
        ∀ (hpw : ∀ (x : Int), ¬x ∈ C ∨ ¬x + 1 ∈ C → O x = O (x + 1)) (y : Int) (hy : VE.Risk.Beyond dir cur y),
          ∃ z,
            z ∈ C ∧
              VE.Risk.Beyond dir cur z ∧
                (match dir, hpw, hy with
                  | VE.Risk.Dir.up, hpw, hy => z ≤ y
                  | VE.Risk.Dir.down, hpw, hy => y ≤ z) ∧
                  O z = O y
  -- expr 2452029081
theorem VE.Risk.walk_down
  ∀ {α : Type} {O : Int → α} {C : List Int} (cur : Int),
    cur - 1 ∈ C →
      (∀ (x : Int), ¬x ∈ C ∨ ¬x + 1 ∈ C → O x = O (x + 1)) →
        ∀ (n : Nat) (y : Int), y = cur - 1 - ↑n → ∃ z, z ∈ C ∧ z < cur ∧ y ≤ z ∧ O z = O y
  -- expr 3307305628

            (fun es row =>
              match row with
              | [a, b] => Std.HashSet.insert es (a, b)
              | x => es)
            es rows)
          (a, b) =
        Bool.true ↔
      Std.HashSet.contains es (a, b) = Bool.true ∨ [a, b] ∈ rows
  -- expr 2293871047

theorem VE.Route.route_acceptance
  ∀ {L : VE.Route.Semantics} {Doc : Type} (R : VE.Route.Layer L Doc) (background : List L.Formula),
    VE.Route.BackgroundSound R background →
      ∀ (checker : VE.Route.Checker L R.E_out) (d : Doc) (Γ : List L.Formula) (φ : L.Formula) (c : checker.Cert)
        (ps : List checker.Stmt) (r : checker.Stmt),
        checker.valid c ps r →
          List.map checker.formula ps = VE.Route.checkedPremises R background d Γ →
            checker.formula r = φ →
              L.Entails R.E_out (VE.Route.checkedPremises R background d Γ) φ ∧
                (∀ (S : L.Model), R.Admissible_out S → R.Intended d S → L.Sat S Γ → L.Holds S φ) ∧
                  ((∀ (a : L.Formula), a ∈ Γ → L.WellFormed R.E_in a) →
                    L.WellFormed R.E_in φ → ∀ (S₀ : L.Model), R.Admissible_in S₀ → L.Sat S₀ Γ → L.Holds S₀ φ)
  -- expr 3546371311

      VE.Service.GenericReadings.Choice sets refuted →

            (∃ choice,
                VE.Service.GenericReadings.Choice sets choice ∧
                  VE.Service.GenericGraph.Ent Adm Holds (B ++ fixed ++ choice) φ) ∧
              ∃ choice,
                VE.Service.GenericReadings.Choice sets choice ∧
                  ¬VE.Service.GenericGraph.Ent Adm Holds (B ++ fixed ++ choice) φ

theorem VE.SoftNorms.universal_down
  ∀ {D : VE.SoftNorms.SoftDoc} {B₀ B : VE.Structure} (e : B₀.Carrier → B.Carrier),
    (∀ (x y : B₀.Carrier), e x = e y → x = y) →
      (∀ (c : String), B.constant c = Option.map e (B₀.constant c)) →
        (∀ (p : String) (vs : List B₀.Carrier),
            ((VE.Norms.envAt (VE.SoftNorms.soften D) 0).predicates p).isSome = Bool.true →
              (B₀.relation p vs ↔ B.relation p (List.map e vs))) →
          (∀ (s : String) (v : B₀.Carrier), B₀.domain s v → B.domain s (e v)) →
            ∀ (φ : VE.Formula) (Γ : List String) (ρ : VE.Valuation B₀),
              VE.SoftNorms.universalQF φ = Bool.true →
                VE.Formula.WellFormed (VE.Norms.envAt (VE.SoftNorms.soften D) 0) Γ φ →
                  VE.Formula.denote B (List.map e ρ) φ → VE.Formula.denote B₀ ρ φ

theorem VE.SoftNorms.weighing_point_sound
  ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] (D : VE.SoftNorms.SoftDoc),
    VE.SoftNorms.WellFormedSoft D = Bool.true →
      ∀ (M N : VE.SoftNorms.SoftNode),
        (M, N) ∈ VE.SoftNorms.collidingPairs D →
          ∀ (Mo : VE.FiniteModel α),
            Mo.Valid (VE.Norms.envAt (VE.SoftNorms.soften D) 0) →
              VE.SoftNorms.classificationBackgroundValid D Mo = Bool.true →
                ∀ (vs : List α),
                  VE.TupleTyped Mo.asStructure (VE.SoftNorms.actSorts D M) vs →
                    VE.Formula.eval Mo (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs)
                          ((VE.SoftNorms.circ D (VE.SoftNorms.selects' D M)).and
                            (VE.SoftNorms.circ D (VE.SoftNorms.selects' D N))) =
                        Bool.true →
                      ¬VE.Formula.denote Mo.asStructure [] (VE.SoftNorms.cohPremise D M N) ∧
                        ¬∀ (B : VE.Structure),
                            VE.Norms.BaseAdmissible (VE.SoftNorms.soften D) B →
                              VE.Norms.ConflictFree (VE.SoftNorms.soften D) B
  -- expr 2380438466
theorem VE.SoftNorms.weighing_points_complete
  ∀ (D : VE.SoftNorms.SoftDoc),
    VE.SoftNorms.WellFormedSoft D = Bool.true →
      ∀ (S : VE.Structure) (ρ : VE.Valuation S),
        (∀ (p : String),
            VE.SoftNorms.DefaultDecidesD D S ρ p Bool.true →
              VE.SoftNorms.DefaultDecidesD D S ρ p Bool.false →
                ∃ M N,
                  (M, N) ∈ VE.SoftNorms.collidingPairs D ∧
                    M.pred = p ∧
                      N.pred = p ∧
                        VE.SoftNorms.SelectsSoftD D S ρ (VE.SoftNorms.fuel D) M ∧
                          VE.SoftNorms.SelectsSoftD D S ρ (VE.SoftNorms.fuel D) N ∧
                            VE.SoftNorms.Comparable D M N = Bool.false) ∧
          ∀ (pr : VE.Norms.Pair),
            pr ∈ VE.Norms.pairs (VE.SoftNorms.soften D).T →
              VE.SoftNorms.DefaultDecidesD D S ρ pr.req Bool.true →
                VE.SoftNorms.DefaultDecidesD D S ρ pr.perm Bool.false →
                  ∃ M N,
                    (M, N) ∈ VE.SoftNorms.collidingPairs D ∧
                      (M.pred = pr.req ∧ N.pred = pr.perm ∨ M.pred = pr.perm ∧ N.pred = pr.req) ∧
                        VE.SoftNorms.SelectsSoftD D S ρ (VE.SoftNorms.fuel D) M ∧
                          VE.SoftNorms.SelectsSoftD D S ρ (VE.SoftNorms.fuel D) N ∧
                            VE.SoftNorms.Comparable D M N = Bool.false
  -- expr 2963663782

theorem VE.SpeechActs.Run.speech_wire_answer_sound
  ∀ (j : Lean.Json) (r : VE.SpeechActs.Run.AnswerCase),
    VE.SpeechActs.Run.replayAnswer j = Except.ok r →
      VE.SpeechActs.WellFormedSpeech r.dec.D = Bool.true ∧
        r.q ∈ r.dec.D.questions ∧
          (∀ (a : VE.SpeechActs.Answer) (φ : VE.Formula) (hφ : VE.SpeechActs.correct r.dec.D r.q a = Option.some φ)
              (c : VE.Tableau.Certificate) (s : VE.SpeechActs.Run.PremiseStatus r.dec.D (VE.SpeechActs.premises r.dec.D)),
              r.replay = VE.SpeechActs.Run.AnswerReplay.certificate a φ hφ c s →
                r.replay.accepted = Bool.true →
                  ∀ (S : VE.Structure),
                    S.Admissible (VE.SpeechActs.En r.dec.D) →
                      VE.Norms.Sat S (VE.SpeechActs.premises r.dec.D) → VE.SpeechActs.AnswersAt r.dec.D r.q S a) ∧
            (∀ (a : VE.SpeechActs.Answer) (φ : VE.Formula) (hφ : VE.SpeechActs.correct r.dec.D r.q a = Option.some φ)
                (c : VE.Tableau.Certificate)
                (s :
                  VE.SpeechActs.Run.PremiseStatus r.dec.D
                    (VE.SpeechActs.premises r.dec.D ++ [VE.SpeechActs.presupposition r.dec.D r.q])),
                r.replay = VE.SpeechActs.Run.AnswerReplay.conditional a φ hφ c s →
                  r.replay.accepted = Bool.true →
                    ∀ (S : VE.Structure),
                      S.Admissible (VE.SpeechActs.En r.dec.D) →
                        VE.Norms.Sat S (VE.SpeechActs.premises r.dec.D) →
                          VE.Formula.denote S [] (VE.SpeechActs.presupposition r.dec.D r.q) →
                            VE.SpeechActs.AnswersAt r.dec.D r.q S a) ∧
              (∀ (c : VE.Tableau.Certificate)
                  (s : VE.SpeechActs.Run.PremiseStatus r.dec.D (VE.SpeechActs.premises r.dec.D)),
                  r.replay = VE.SpeechActs.Run.AnswerReplay.presuppositionFailed c s →
                    r.replay.accepted = Bool.true →
                      ∀ (S : VE.Structure),
                        S.Admissible (VE.SpeechActs.En r.dec.D) →
                          VE.Norms.Sat S (VE.SpeechActs.premises r.dec.D) →
                            ∀ (a : VE.SpeechActs.Answer), ¬VE.SpeechActs.AnswersAt r.dec.D r.q S a) ∧
                ∀ (id : String) (m : VE.SpeechActs.Run.CheckedModel r.dec.D (VE.SpeechActs.premises r.dec.D)),
                  r.replay = VE.SpeechActs.Run.AnswerReplay.model id m →
                    ∀ (a : VE.SpeechActs.Answer),
                      VE.SpeechActs.answerEval r.dec.D r.q m.M a = Bool.true ↔
                        VE.SpeechActs.AnswersAt r.dec.D r.q m.M.asStructure a
  -- expr 4290595908

        ∀ (Γ : List VE.Formula) (φ : VE.Formula) (c : VE.Tableau.Certificate),
          VE.Tableau.checkCertificate (VE.SpeechActs.En D)
                (VE.Norms.background (VE.SpeechActs.policy D) ++ VE.Norms.elaborate (VE.SpeechActs.policy D).T ++ Γ) φ c =
              Bool.true →
            (∀ (S : VE.Structure),
                S.Admissible (VE.SpeechActs.En D) →
                  VE.Norms.holdsCatala (VE.SpeechActs.policy D).T S →
                    VE.Norms.definitionsHold (VE.SpeechActs.policy D) S →
                      VE.Norms.profileHold (VE.SpeechActs.policy D) S →
                        VE.Norms.Sat S (VE.Norms.backgroundBase (VE.SpeechActs.policy D)) →
                          VE.Norms.Sat S Γ → VE.Formula.denote S [] φ) ∧
              ((∀ (a : VE.Formula), a ∈ Γ → VE.Formula.WellFormed (VE.Norms.envAt (VE.SpeechActs.policy D) 0) [] a) →
                VE.Formula.WellFormed (VE.Norms.envAt (VE.SpeechActs.policy D) 0) [] φ →
                  ∀ (B : VE.Structure),
                    VE.Norms.BaseAdmissible (VE.SpeechActs.policy D) B → VE.Norms.Sat B Γ → VE.Formula.denote B [] φ)

            let rest ← VE.Surface.consume ['.', '\n'] rest
            let tail ← VE.Surface.parseStatements E fuel rest

theorem VE.Time.Document.admitDecoded_sound
  ∀ {w : VE.Time.Wire.W6Env} (D : VE.Time.Document.QDoc w) (nodes : List (VE.Time.Document.QNode w)) (root : String)
    (res : VE.Time.Document.Admitted w),
    VE.Time.Document.admitDecoded w D nodes root = Except.ok res →
      res.doc = D ∧
        res.nodes = nodes ∧
          res.root.name = root ∧
            (∃ n, n ∈ nodes ∧ n.name = root ∧ n.adm = res.root.adm ∧ n.label = res.root.label) ∧
              (∀ (n : VE.Time.Document.QNode w), n ∈ nodes → VE.Time.Document.NodeAdmitted D n) ∧
                (∀ (x : String × VE.Time.Wire.Admission w × String),
                    x ∈ res.root.assumptions →
                      ∃ n,
                        n ∈ nodes ∧
                          n.deduction = Option.none ∧ (n.name, n.adm, n.label) = x ∧ VE.Time.Document.LeafAdmitted D n) ∧
                  VE.Time.Document.CitationsClosed D res.root ∧
                    VE.Time.Document.ChoicesCompatible res.root ∧ res.root.Sound ∧ res.root.SoundOverLeaves
  -- expr 1081778136

theorem VE.Time.expandFrom_iff
  ∀ (S : VE.Order.Structure) (ρ : VE.Order.Valuation S) (s : String) (body : VE.Order.Formula) (r j : Nat)
    (ws : List S.Carrier),
    1 ≤ r →
      ws.length = j - 1 →
        1 ≤ j →
          ws.Nodup →
            (VE.Order.Formula.denote S (List.map Sum.inl ws ++ ρ) (VE.Time.expandFrom s body j r) ↔
              ∃ ys,
                ys.length = r ∧
                  (ys ++ ws).Nodup ∧
                    ∀ (y : S.Carrier), y ∈ ys → S.objects s y ∧ VE.Order.Formula.denote S (Sum.inl y :: ρ) body)
  -- expr 2930854340

theorem VE.Time.findMonth_spec

    1 ≤ m →
      m ≤ 12 →
        VE.Time.daysBeforeMonth y m ≤ r →
          12 ≤ m + fuel →
            1 ≤ VE.Time.findMonth y r fuel m ∧
              VE.Time.findMonth y r fuel m ≤ 12 ∧
                VE.Time.daysBeforeMonth y (VE.Time.findMonth y r fuel m) ≤ r ∧
                  (VE.Time.findMonth y r fuel m = 12 ∨ r < VE.Time.daysBeforeMonth y (VE.Time.findMonth y r fuel m + 1))

      ∀ (phase : String) (root : Lean.Json) (items earlier : List VE.WireContract.Pointer) (frame : VE.WireContract.Frame)
        (e : VE.WireContract.Entry),
        VE.WireContract.expand h phase root items earlier frame e =
          VE.WireContract.expand g phase root items earlier frame e
  -- expr 3782818951
theorem VE.WireContract.findSome_congr_reached
  ∀ {α β : Type} (f g : α → Option β) (l : List α),
    (∀ (pre : List α) (i : α) (post : List α),
        l = pre ++ i :: post → (∀ (b : α), b ∈ pre → f b = Option.none) → f i = g i) →
      List.findSome? f l = List.findSome? g l
  -- expr 4026542285
theorem VE.WireContract.instances_views
  ∀ (t : VE.WireContract.Table) (h g : VE.WireContract.Hooks) (j : Lean.Json),
    h.view = g.view → VE.WireContract.instances t h j = VE.WireContract.instances t g j
  -- expr 2026301044
theorem VE.WireContract.run_clean_iff
  ∀ (t : VE.WireContract.Table) (h : VE.WireContract.Hooks) (j : Lean.Json),
    VE.WireContract.run t h j = Option.none ↔
      ∀ (i : VE.WireContract.Instance), i ∈ VE.WireContract.instances t h j → VE.WireContract.eval h i = Option.none
  -- expr 2461934327
theorem VE.WireContract.run_congr_reached
  ∀ (t : VE.WireContract.Table) (h g : VE.WireContract.Hooks) (j : Lean.Json),
    (∀ (name : String) (v : Lean.Json), h.view name v = g.view name v) →
      (∀ (pre : List VE.WireContract.Instance) (i : VE.WireContract.Instance) (post : List VE.WireContract.Instance),
          VE.WireContract.instances t h j = pre ++ i :: post →
            (∀ (b : VE.WireContract.Instance), b ∈ pre → VE.WireContract.eval h b = Option.none) →
              VE.WireContract.eval h i = VE.WireContract.eval g i) →
        VE.WireContract.run t h j = VE.WireContract.run t g j
  -- expr 1139376111
theorem VE.WireContract.run_fault_first
  ∀ (t : VE.WireContract.Table) (h : VE.WireContract.Hooks) (j : Lean.Json) (d : VE.WireContract.Finding),
    VE.WireContract.run t h j = Option.some d ↔
      ∃ pre i post,
        VE.WireContract.instances t h j = pre ++ i :: post ∧
          VE.WireContract.eval h i = Option.some d ∧
            ∀ (b : VE.WireContract.Instance), b ∈ pre → VE.WireContract.eval h b = Option.none
  -- expr 2641608036
theorem VE.WireContract.run_phase_major
  ∀ (t : VE.WireContract.Table) (ps qs : List VE.WireContract.Phase) (h : VE.WireContract.Hooks) (j : Lean.Json),
    t.phases = ps ++ qs →
      VE.WireContract.run t h j =
        (VE.WireContract.run { contract := t.contract, revision := t.revision, residual := t.residual, phases := ps } h
              j).or
          (VE.WireContract.run { contract := t.contract, revision := t.revision, residual := t.residual, phases := qs } h
            j)
  -- expr 564536149

theorem VE.countermodelCheck_iff
  ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] (M : VE.FiniteModel α) (premises : List VE.Formula) (conclusion : VE.Formula),
    VE.countermodelCheck M premises conclusion = Bool.true ↔
      (∀ (a : VE.Formula), a ∈ premises → VE.Formula.denote M.asStructure [] a) ∧
        ¬VE.Formula.denote M.asStructure [] conclusion
  -- expr 2111548465

    M.Valid E →
      ∀ (premises : List VE.Formula) (conclusion : VE.Formula),
        VE.countermodelCheck M premises conclusion = Bool.true → ¬VE.Entails E premises conclusion

theorem VE.term_defined
  ∀ {E : VE.Environment} {S : VE.Structure},
    S.Admissible E →
      ∀ {Γ : List String} {ρ : VE.Valuation S},
        VE.Valuation.Typed S Γ ρ →
          ∀ {t : VE.Term} {s : String},
            VE.Term.sortOf E Γ t = Option.some s → ∃ v, VE.Term.denote S ρ t = Option.some v ∧ S.domain s v
  -- expr 3168590851
